# Freemius WordPress SDK

This directory contains the unmodified Freemius WordPress SDK 2.13.5 source archive, including its GPL-3.0-only license. Composer installs it using the relative distribution path in `composer.json`; `composer.lock` records the version and archive checksum.

Archive SHA-256: `7451f10e39c936958a655784b8c63e7be18ed3ddb33383819b03910e48db04a9`.

Keep this archive available while installing dependencies. Production plugin packages include the installed SDK in `vendor/freemius/wordpress-sdk` and exclude this build input directory.
